cases.label: alumina
cases.scope: Tube contacts plates directly; normal case has0.5mm clearance between metal holder and plates. Touch case bridges that clearance. Alumina_touch deliberately tests a metal-holder shunt despite insulating chamber. Mechanical mounting/clamps absent; no sealing or current result yet.

stock_scope: Manufacturer lists2mmOD/1mmID99.7%alumina tube; cut/lap short length, dimensions/fits and thermal contact not qualified.
conductivity_scope: Initial geometry cases use existing fixedCu25MS/m,SS1.1MS/m,liquid2.2MS/m andidealinterfaces. Aluminium bar conductivity needs a separately documented sensitivity; it is not silently assumed superior.

rejected_variant.reason: Lower holder overlaps each existing pole by2.4mm3; rejected by exact CAD overlap check.

scope: One untested geometry candidate. Short ceramic insert has a nominal0.1mm radial locating shoulder. No sealing, retention, thermal or flow result. Metal reservoir can provide a current bypass reached through liquid.
